task: Subagent proof live drive: one budgeted live Claude Agent SDK session, driven as an end user in a real PTY, that finally proves proofpunk-agent's agent tree renders real spawned subagents end-to-end (SDK stream -> AGENT_SPAWNED event -> tree reducer -> Session Screen 1 rail).
gathered_by: orchestrator (spec_gatherer subagent unavailable: 'Invalid JSON response' on every spawn; requirements derived from direct repository inspection)
sources_inspected: proofpunk_agent/state/events.py (EventLog in-memory only; no disk export exists)
proofpunk_agent/screens/session.py (glyph table, agent_tree_lines(), Depth:/Active: summary, (unattributed) label)
validation/e2e/screen23_live.py (live-drive conventions: one session, $15 ceiling, prompt engineering, F12 capture rename, max_turns shim)

functional_requirements.requirement: Single live session: the drive boots python3 -m proofpunk_agent with the plugin loaded, in one real PTY sized >= 100x28 (120x34 preferred), passing the spawn-inducing prompt as the positional PROMPT argument and a hard USD ceiling via --max-budget.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one live SDK session is paid for in the run
Budget ceiling recorded in the driver argv and echoed in the evidence log
Boot confirmed by waiting for the app's boot marker before sending keys

functional_requirements.requirement: Spawn-inducing prompt: the PROMPT explicitly instructs the model to delegate work to subagent(s) via the built-in spawning tool, names the spawn tool candidates the bridge recognizes, and bounds the work so the turn terminates.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt text archived verbatim in the run dir
Prompt requests at least one subagent delegation and one nested (subagent-of-subagent) delegation as a stretch ask
Prompt tells the model to stop after the delegated work returns

functional_requirements.requirement: Primary assertion (PASS-critical Arm A): a captured Session Screen 1 frame shows the AGENT TREE pane with at least one non-root glyph row indented under the orchestrator, and a 'Depth: N' line with N >= 1.
acceptance_criteria: At least one captured frame (text scrape and/or F12 SVG) contains a glyph row at indentation depth 1 whose label is not 'orchestrator'
The same frame (or a frame from the same turn) shows 'Depth: ' with value >= 1
'Active:' count line present; observed value recorded verbatim

functional_requirements.requirement: Cross-screen corroboration: a captured Screen 2 (tools/ledger) frame shows a tool row whose name is a bridge-recognized spawn tool ('Agent' or 'Task').
acceptance_criteria: Captured Screen 2 frame contains 'Agent' or 'Task' as an observed tool name
The observed spawn-tool name distribution is recorded verbatim (never assumed)

functional_requirements.requirement: Observation instrument (optional but preferred): a PYTHONPATH sitecustomize shim exports the driven app's in-memory EventLog to a JSON file at shutdown, WITHOUT altering ClaudeAgentOptions, event contents, or any product file. If used, the dump becomes the disk corroboration artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Shim touches no product file and changes no SDK option or Event payload
Dump file archived in the run dir; contains at least one AGENT_SPAWNED event with subject set
Offline fold of the dumped log through reduce_tree reproduces the same max_depth and node count as the live frame claimed

functional_requirements.requirement: Nested-tree stretch arm (separate verdict, Arm B): if the model nests a subagent inside a subagent, a captured frame shows a glyph row at indentation depth >= 2 and 'Depth: N' with N >= 2; parentage comes only from the SDK-provided linkage, never driver inference.
acceptance_criteria: Depth-2 row observed in a captured frame, OR Arm B recorded as NOT-OBSERVED with the raw tree-frame sequence attached
No driver-side parent inference from timing, names, or log proximity

functional_requirements.requirement: Attribution honesty arm (record-only, Arm C): the run records the attribution tier distribution observed for tree-attached nodes, including any '(unattributed)' labeled rows, exactly as rendered.
acceptance_criteria: Verdict reports counts of tier-3 (parent_tool_use_id) links vs '(unattributed)' fallback rows
No attempt to hide, relabel, or repair unattributed rows during the run

functional_requirements.requirement: Permission-gate handling: if the spawn or nested tool calls raise the PERMISSION REQUEST modal, the driver answers it (allow/deny keys) and records each modal appearance and the key sent.
acceptance_criteria: Modal watch loop polls for the literal 'PERMISSION REQUEST' title
Every modal appearance + driver response + resulting tree glyph transition (if visible) logged

functional_requirements.requirement: Evidence archive: everything lands under e2e-evidence/run-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>-999-subagent-proof-live-drive/ following the step-NN-<slug> convention: preflight check, driver source, per-step .log files, all frames/SVGs (+PNG conversions where rsvg-convert available), the EventLog dump if FR-05 used, and a final verdict markdown.
acceptance_criteria: Run dir name carries the UTC timestamp and the slug
Verdict file gives PASS/FAIL/NOT-OBSERVED/ABANDONED per arm with the frame excerpts that justify each
No pytest, no mocks, stubs, or fakes anywhere in citable artifacts

functional_requirements.requirement: Abandon and defect criteria are explicit: budget exhausted with zero spawns observed -> verdict ABANDONED (with raw tool-name distribution); CLI unreachable or plugin root rejected at preflight -> verdict BLOCKED; any product defect exposed (wrong glyph, missing pane, crash) -> a finding .md in the run dir, and remediation happens as a follow-up step-NN, never silently.
acceptance_criteria: Driver stops spending at the ceiling and writes ABANDONED verdict with what WAS observed
Defects documented as findings before any fix is attempted; fixes re-driven only within remaining budget or a new run dir

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Honesty doctrine: every number in the verdict (depth, active count, cost, tier distribution) is read off a captured frame or the event dump; nothing is estimated or invented.
acceptance_criteria: Each verdict claim cites the artifact it came from

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Terminal floor respected: PTY never sized below 100x28; resize behavior is out of scope for this run.
acceptance_criteria: Driver asserts PTY dimensions >= 100x28 at boot

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Cost ceiling: total live spend bounded by the --max-budget value ($15 default, matching the screen23_live precedent).
acceptance_criteria: --max-budget present in argv; spend figure recorded in verdict if the app exposes it

out_of_scope: Offline-only tree rendering proof (already delivered by run-20260909T000144-p5-screen1 step-14)
Product changes to _SPAWN_TOOL_NAMES, the tree reducer, or the session screen unless the live drive exposes a defect
open_questions: Q1: Will the model reliably call the spawn tool from a plain instruction? Mitigated by explicit prompt naming the tool and by ABANDONED verdict path.
Q2: Which spawn-tool name does this host emit ('Agent' vs 'Task')? Recorded, never assumed (historical defect root cause).
Q3: Do spawn tool calls trigger the permission modal on this host? Recorded via FR-08 loop.
Q4: Is depth-2 nesting achievable within budget? Treated as Arm B NOT-OBSERVED fallback.
Q5: Does the EventLog shutdown dump (FR-05 shim) capture cleanly on app exit paths? Pre-checked in preflight step against the quit path.
